text.autoconfig.hudrendererlib.option.ad: Adjust Top Right Elements With Status Effects

Shifts elements with the "Top Right" alignment down by the specified amount of pixels below if potion effects are being overlayed in the top right. Only applies while Show Vanilla Status Effects is on.
Adjust Top Right Elements With Status Effects Amount
text.autoconfig.hudrendererlib.option.ma: Wraps every element's text at this width in GUI pixels, between words and never inside one. At 0 each element uses its own default width, and most elements have none. An element's own Max Width override, also set in the HUD Element Editor, takes precedence.
text.autoconfig.hudrendererlib.option.sh: Show the game's status effect icons in the top right of the screen.
